test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

A statement had already been issued to the press on the lockdown by the authorities.

options.text: The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.
The authorities have already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.
A statement had already issued the authorities to the press on the lockdown.
The authorities are already issuing a statement to the press on the lockdown.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Past Perfect Tense and **Passive** Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Past Perfect Tense from** Passive voice to Active voice**:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• Structure__: Subject + had + past participle (V3) + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + had + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 __
 
• Example: *Disha had arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things had been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'The authorities had already issued a statement to the press on the lockdown.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Past Perfect Tense और Passive Voice में है।
 
• Past Perfect Tense को **Passive Voice से Active voice** में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का Object, Passive Voice का Subject बन जाता है।
 
• संरचना__: Subject + had + past participle (V3) + object __(Active Voice)__

 Object + had + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
• Example: *Disha had arranged the things. *(Active Voice)

 * The things had been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
